## Is your feature request related to a problem?

Describe the problem or friction you would like to solve.

## What would you like to happen?

Describe the feature or behavior you have in mind.

## Why would this be useful?

Who would benefit, and how?

## Possible approach

If you have an implementation idea, share it here. It is fine if you do not.

## Local-first considerations

Would this feature work entirely in the browser, or would it require accounts, a backend, cloud sync, or sending data to another service?

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternatives or workarounds you have considered.
